part.text:
Fixed. In `remove` (tokio-util/src/time/delay_queue.rs:760), when the last item is removed the queue's deadline becomes `None`; the fix now takes and wakes the stored waker so a concurrently pending `poll_expired` re-polls and returns `Ready(None)`.

Verified: `cargo test -p tokio-util --features full` passes, including the `wake_after_remove_last` test (33/33 in `time_delay_queue`) and the rest of the suite.
